original.evidence: Plans/.audits/fable-20260706/buildability_repair_registry.jsonl:133 asks for the redaction and observability data contracts, hook, quota and sampling algorithm. Plans/FileSafe.md#F2-195 applies RedactionSettlement “before UI/render/persistence for tool/terminal/model outputs”. At :14719 the standard trace write path is “(1) sensitivity classification, (2) `RedactionSettlement` (F2-195), (3) severity and sampling filter, (4) quota check, and (5) write” and counts serialized bytes after redaction. At :14723–14745 both records are closed and typed, including decision-dependent artifact/reason fields and the exact run, terminal-session or diagnostic-bundle quota owner. Plans/FileSafe.md:14749 says “DL-2602 confirms the defaults of 8 MiB per trace and 256 MiB per run.” At :14754–14758 it defines three sampling levels, a numeric 0–1 sample rate and bounded integer limits. At :14763 the selection uses “the first 8 bytes of `sha256(trace_id)`, read as an unsigned big-endian integer and divided by 2^64” and compares that with the rate. At :14769 “The write must fit both applicable caps” including the specified restricted 10% reserves. At :14771 the writer maintains monotonic saturating totals and requires Storage registration before durable publication of the diagnostic marker. The overflow example at :14773 matches the specified reserves and 1,081,344 refused bytes. The pre-write and retention exception for encrypted, opt-in local debug capture stays governed by F2-196.
